notes:
The board used for ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ (Japanese chess). Composed of ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ (shogi) + ⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧ (board). A standard {将棋盤|しょうぎばん} has a 9x9 grid of 81 squares. Professional and formal boards are thick blocks of wood, often made from {榧|かや} (Japanese torreya), and stand on four legs.
